PREFIX core: <http://vivoweb.org/ontology/core#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX vcard: <http://www.w3.org/2006/vcard/ns#>
SELECT ?vcard (group_concat(distinct ?linkLabel;separator="/") as ?label) ?url WHERE { ?subject ?property ?vcard . ?vcard rdfs:label ?linkLabel . ?vcard vcard:url ?url . } GROUP BY ?vcard ?url ORDER BY ?linkLabel
